choice.basis: The dashboard (chart_1) shows a strong, nearly linear positive midyear association: as Advertising Spend ($ thousands) rises from ~30 (May) to ~70 (September), Sales ($ thousands) rise from ~71 to ~175 (points at ~[30,71], [40,115], [50,142], [60,162], [70,175]). However, the visible evidence is limited to May–September, and the chart contains no causal, ROI, profitability, or approval-criterion marks. The task requires choosing an approval or evidence-review decision. Because the dashboard supplies only a midyear association without the full-year or causal/profitability validation needed to justify a 'broader budget increase,' the positive task basis is to hold and request the full-year analysis rather than approve on the partial association or defer.
choice.option_label: Select 'Hold and request full-year marketing analysis'
